name: Security Bond Attestation
description: Takes a WHA request (ACCOUNTS: BTC, ETH, SOL wallets by CAIP-2 chain) and answers a WHA attestation: native balances, ERC-20/SPL tokens and USD quotes read from free public services through the host's http capability. Chain logic stays in WASM.

methods.description: Reads each requested account's holdings from a free public service, prices them in USD and returns one WHA (PURPOSE security-bond, CURRENCY USD, AS_OF_MS from the clock). A lookup that fails contributes nothing, its chain is marked incomplete and named in ERRORS; a holding that could not be priced is VALUED false, never zero. An unknown chain or a malformed address answers ERRORS ["invalid request"] with nothing read.
